definitions.usage: × as, but, for(-asmuch ), now, of, seeing, than, that, therefore, until, what (-soever), when, which, whom, whose.
definitions.full: H1768. di דִּי particle of relation , who, which, that , used also as mark of Genitive and conjunction that, because (Aramaic of Nineveh, Babylonian, Zinjirli, Nerab, Cilicia, Têma, Egypt, ןי (Lzb 267. 446 RES 361 S-C Pap. A 2 +); Nabataean, Palmyrene די ; דְּ ᵑ7 (except in compounds, as דִּילִי mine , דִּילֵיהּ his ); Samaritan ; Syriac ; Ethiopic za: of same origin as Arabic possessor of [compare below Biblical Hebrew זֶה ]. Properly a demonstrative that [compare זֶה ; in Ethiopic ze is 'this', za 'which']; but this being referred by usage to something preceding becomes equivalent to the relative who, which , used, however, more widely than Hebrew אֲשֶׁר ); — 1 as rel. who, which (construed like אֲשֶׁר ): a. Jer 10:11 ; Dan 2:11 מְדָֽרְהוֺן דִּי whose dwelling, 2:24 מַלְבָּא מַנִּי דִּי whom the king had appointed, 2:26 בּ שְׁמֵהּ ׳דִּי whose name was B., 4:5 ; 5:12 , 23 , etc.; = that which 2:23 ; = him that Ezra 7:25 ; 6:15 ; Dan 7:17 אַרְבַּע אִנוּן דִּת which are four (see אִנּוּן ). Following pronoun of 2 person (compare אֲשֶׁר 3 ), 2:37 thou, O king ..., לָח יְהַב ֗֗֗ דִּי to whom ... hath given, 4:19 ; 4:6 as to whom I know, etc. (compare אֲשֶׁר 4d end ). Sq. תַּמָּה = where Ezra 6:1 , so דִּי alone 6:3 ; Dan 2:38 ; of time, דִּי בְּעִדָּנָא at the time when , etc., 3:5 , 15 . With the predicate an infinitive with לְ , 6:9 לְהַשְׁנָיָה לָא דִּי כְּתָבָא which is not to be changed, Ezra 6:8 ; a place- or other determination, Dan 3:20 valiant men בְחֵילֵהּ that were in his army, 5:2 בִירוּשְׁלֵב דִּי הֵיכְלָא , 7:20 ; Ezra 4:24 ; 5:6 ; 6:2 , 6 ; compare Dan 2:25 ; 5:13 ; 7:7 ; Ezra 7:23 . לָא דִּי = without , 6:9 ; 7:22 (so ᵑ7 דְּלָא Gen 15:2 ; Exod 21:11 ); compare Dan 2:34 , 45 . b. דִּי מָה דִּי, מָן (compare in late Hebrew מַה ׳מַהשֶּֿׁ, 1e b ) whoever, whatever , so 3:6 , 11 ָ(מןדִּֿילָֿא יִמֵּל whoever does not fall down, 4:14 יִצְבֵּא דִּי לְמָן to whomsoever he willeth, 4:22 ; 4:29 ; 5:21 ; דִי מָה whatever (or simply what ), 2:28 לֶהֱוֵא דִּי מָה what will be, 2:29 ; 2:29 ; 2:45 ; Ezra 6:8 ; 7:18 . — compare K § 103. 2 as mark of the Genitive , Dan 2:15 מלכא די שׁליטא properly the captain, that of the king = the king's captain (a Genuine Aramaic idiom: so דְּ ᵑ7 , Syriac constantly), 2:19 ; 2:25 ; 2:49 +? Ezra 4:15 ; 5:2 , etc., or in the absolute state (undetermined), Dan 5:5 ; 7:4 , 9 , 10 נוּר דִּי נְהַר ; or it may have a pleonastic suffix, 2:20 אֱלָהָא דִּי שְׁמֵהּ literally his name, that of God = God's name , 2:44 ; 3:8 , 25 , 26 ; 4:23 , etc. (so also ᵑ7 Syriac). To circumscribe an adjective, especially in specification of the material: 2:38 thou art דַהֲבָא דִּי רֵאשָׁה the head of gold, 2:39 ; 3:1 ; 5:7 , 16 ; Ezra 5:14 ; 6:4 +; as predicate Dan 2:32 טָב דִּידְֿהַב רֵאשֵׁהּ his head (was) of fine gold, 2:33 ; 7:19 ; with a pronoun 2:20 wisdom and might הִיא דִּילֵֿהּ are his ; compare 6:27 תִתְחַבַּל דִּילָֿא וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ his kingdom (is one) which shall not be destroyed, 7:14 . — See further K § 81. 3 as conjunction (compare אֲשֶׁר 8 ): a. that (quod) , after verbs of knowing, Dan 2:8-9 , seeing 2:45 ; 3:27 , hearing 5:14 , etc.; introducing the subject of a sentence, ֗֗֗ דִּי ֗֗֗ יְדִיעַ 3:18 ; Ezra 4:13 ; Dan 2:47 ֗֗֗ דִּי מִןקְֿשֹׁט True is it that . . . (compare כִּי אָמְנָם Job 12:2 ). b. = in that, inasmuch as, whereas: Dan 2:41 and whereas ( דִּי ) thou sawest, etc. . . . it shall be adivided kingdom, 2:43 ; 4:20 ; 4:23 ; as a connecting link$ = seeing that, because, for (compare אֲשֶׁר 8c ) 2:9 , 20 b; 2:23 b; 2:47 b; 4:15 ; 6:24 b. c. that (ut) , after verbs of asking Dan 2:16 , commanding 3:10 , 29 , expressing a purpose 4:3 ; 5:15 ; Ezra 4:15 ; 6:10 +; לָא דִּי that not (ne) Dan 2:18 ; 3:28 ; 6:18 (on לְמָה דִּי lest Ezra 7:23 , see מה ). d. prefixed to direct narr. (like כִּי 1b , and sometimes אֲשֶׁר 8a γ , and ὅτι recitativum ), Dan 2:25 and said thus unto him דִּיהַֿשְׁכַּחַת (that) I have found, etc., 5:7 ; 6:6 ; 6:14 . 4 with prepositions and other prefixes: a. דִי כְּ (like Hebrew כַּאֲשֶׁר ; so Egyptian Aramaic כזי , Palmyrene, Nabataean כדי , Lzb 293 SAC G1 62, 63 Cooke 369b RES:361 ; כַּד ᵑ7 , Syriac ); a according as , Dan 2:43 ; b. so soon as, when , 3:7 ; 5:20 ; 6:11 ; 6:15 . b. מִןדִּֿי : a. because that , Dan 3:22 ; Ezra 5:12 (compare מֵאֲשֶׁר Isa 43:4 ); b. from (the time) that, after (ex quo) , Dan 4:23 ; Ezra 4:23 . c. דִּי עַד until , Dan 2:9 , 34 ; 4:30 ; 7:22 ; = ere that 6:25 . d. דִּי עַל Dan 3:19 is not a conjunction, but means above that which ... e. for דִּי דִּבְרַת עַל and דִּי כָּלקֳֿבֵל see [ דִּבְרָה ] and קֳבֵל . כְּ particle like, as, about (Biblical Hebrew כְּ , q. v.); — like, as Dan 2:40 כְּפַרְוְלָא תַּקִּיפָא , 4:5 ; 4:32 ; 5:1 +; according to 4:32 עָכֵד מִצְבְּיֵהּ וּכְּ and according to his will he doeth, Ezra 6:9 , 18 +; about (as Biblical Hebrew 1a: compare Zinjirli Lzb 444 [ ן ] מלכ כשלשן ), Dan 4:16 חֲדָה כְּשָׁעָה , 6:1 ; with infinitive (Biblical Hebrew 3b ), 6:21 לִגֻבָּא מִקְרְנֵהּ וּכְ and as he drew near, etc. Cpds.: — דִי כְּ and כִּדְנָה , see דִּי and דָּאנה ; כַּחֲדָה ; together , see חַד (sub אחד ).
